name: GoPlus Security API (address, token and phishing-site security checks)
tier_rationale: Company with public API documentation and a public track record since 2021 (A8 community); the council recorded 'Registry: GoPlus Security tier community' (P206 cond 6). Its terms could not be verified (documentation is JavaScript-only, 2026-11-26), so every source is 'key-terms' (P206 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Aggregated security labels with a named data_source per flag (e.g. SlowMist, BlockSec); 'sanctioned' is not authoritative (P206 cond 4) and an unsupported chain answers 'ok' with all flags '0' and contract_address '-1' (not evaluated).

goplus.description: GoPlus app key and secret of a company account, as 'app_key:app_secret' (exchanged for a short-lived access token per run; higher limits)
goplus.plan_hint: optional: keyless requests work at low volume; under the corporate profile the sources run only once legal records free_plan_business_use or the key plan is 'business' (key_plans.goplus, P206 cond 5)

address_security.title: GoPlus address_security/{address}?chain_id= (malicious-address flags for EVM and TRON)

terms.quote: GoPlus and Honeypot.is terms could not be verified (docs JS-only, 2026-11-26): class 'key-terms'

address_security.notes: Quote: binding council text (P206 cond 5). Research C0477 (verified_live 200): {'code':1,'message':'ok','result':{flag:'0'|'1',..., data_source, contract_address}}; code != 1 is ERROR (P321); contract_address '-1' (unsupported chain) is 'not evaluated', never clean. GET only. Used by goplus_security.

token_security.title: GoPlus token_security/{chain_id}?contract_addresses= (token contract risks, keyed by the lowercase contract)

terms.quote: GoPlus and Honeypot.is terms could not be verified (docs JS-only, 2026-11-26): class 'key-terms'

token_security.notes: Quote: binding council text (P206 cond 5). Research C0477: answer keyed by the lowercase contract; a non-token answers empty name/symbol and holder_count '0' (not applicable). Queried only for EVM addresses address_security marks as contracts. Used by goplus_security.

phishing_site.title: GoPlus phishing_site?url= (crypto phishing/drainer site flag)

terms.quote: GoPlus and Honeypot.is terms could not be verified (docs JS-only, 2026-11-26): class 'key-terms'

phishing_site.notes: Quote: binding council text (P206 cond 5). Research C0477: phishing_site is an integer 0/1. Only for URLs/domains with crypto context in the case (P206 cond 1); URLs are stripped of query, fragment and userinfo unless the analyst opts in per URL (P206 cond 2). Used by goplus_security.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-1 (P206). Live 2026-11-26: Cloudflare-fronted, 0.3-0.8 s, no rate-limit headers; documented limit code 4029 ('request limit reached') maps to rate_limited. Keyless at low volume: min_interval 2 s, one request at a time, ttl 6 h (crypto labels change slowly; the TTL class 'crypto 1 h' is for balances).
